title: Greeting and Thanksgiving, The Judgment at Christ's Coming

questions.question: Paul, Silvanus, and ____ send this letter to the church of the Thessalonians.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:"

questions.question: Paul says they are bound to give thanks to God for them because their ____ is growing abundantly, and their love for one another is increasing.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:3 (ESV): "We ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers, as is right, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing."

questions.question: Paul boasts about their steadfastness and faith in all their persecutions and in the ____ that they are enduring.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:4 (ESV): "Therefore we ourselves boast about you in the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions that you are enduring."

questions.question: This is evidence of the righteous ____ of God, that they may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which they are also suffering.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:5 (ESV): "This is evidence of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering—"

questions.question: God considers it just to repay with affliction those who afflict them, and to grant ____ to those who are afflicted as well as to Paul and his companions.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:6-7 (ESV): "since indeed God considers it just to repay with affliction those who afflict you, and to grant relief to you who are afflicted as well as to us..."

questions.question: When will this relief be granted? When the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:7 (ESV): "...when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels"

questions.question: He will come in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not ____ the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:8 (ESV): "in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus."

questions.question: They will suffer the punishment of ____ destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:9 (ESV): "They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might,"

questions.question: When he comes on that day to be ____ in his saints, and to be marveled at among all who have believed.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:10 (ESV): "when he comes on that day to be glorified in his saints, and to be marveled at among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed."

questions.question: Paul constantly prays that God may make them worthy of his ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:11 (ESV): "To this end we always pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling..."

questions.question: And that God may fulfill every resolve for good and every work of faith by his ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:11 (ESV): "...and may fulfill every resolve for good and every work of faith by his power,"

questions.question: So that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the ____ of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:12 (ESV): "so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: The punishment for those who do not obey the gospel is separation from the ____ of the Lord.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:9 (ESV): "They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might,"

questions.question: Paul says "our testimony to you was ____." This is why they will be among those who marvel at Christ's coming.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:10 (ESV): "...because our testimony to you was believed."

questions.question: Paul boasts to the churches of God about the Thessalonians' steadfastness and faith in their ____ and afflictions.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 1:4 (ESV): "Therefore we ourselves boast about you in the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions that you are enduring."

key_verse_text: To this end we always pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling and may fulfill every resolve for good and every work of faith by his power, so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
